messages:
maya: Dropping a small prototype for the API Keys panel (rotate/revoke, empty state, copy timing). quick eyes on copy + a11y please: https://figma.com/file/proto-xyz (placeholder)
eli: Quick copy note: in-row actions should be explicit. Use `Rotate key` / `Revoke key` so single-word buttons don't lose context in crowded lists.
jordan: UX: surface `Used by 2 services` under the key and add a `View usage` drawer so people can verify before rotating. For bulk rotate show preview of affected services (first 5 + "and N more").
nora: Accessibility: after rotation announce via aria-live="polite": "New API key created. Use the reveal control to view it." Never speak the secret aloud. Add aria-describedby that points to helper copy: "This is the only time the full key is shown."
sam: Focus/timer: keep modal focus trapped. After rotate move focus to the success panel's `Copy new key` button. Show the key for 15s by default and startTimer(15000). Snippet we can use: ```if (resp.one_time_key) { showKey(resp.key); startTimer(15000); focus(copyBtn); }```
eli: Empty state tweak: instead of "You have no API keys yet." try: "No API keys yet — create one to start calling the API." CTA `Create API key`. Add a tiny curl example: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <KEY>" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/health`
jordan: Revoke flow: if usageCount >= 2 require typed-confirm (enter key name) or a checkbox listing affected services. Otherwise quick revoke with undo snackbar (30s).
nora: Visuals: don't rely on color for danger. Add an icon and screen-reader text like `Danger: revoking this key will invalidate it`. Ensure contrast meets AA.
maya: Telemetry idea: log keys.rotate_shown, keys.rotate_confirmed, keys.rotate_copied (boolean), keys.revoke_confirm_type. Also track rotate-but-no-copy within 30s to catch clipboard issues. Filing KEYUX-999 for implementation and accessibility checks.
dev-bot: staging deploy queued for 07:00 UTC (automated:deploy)
maya: Thanks! I'll update the Figma with ARIA notes, focus targets, timer defaults, and the empty-state curl sample. Will ping when mocks are updated.
